name: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle
label: Quest
description: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Even if you have no need for the material rewards we offer, these badges still mark our mutual trust and friendship.
Bring them to me. I'll make due note of your service should your performance go above and beyond the call of duty.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You honor us, friend. With your continued efforts we will overcome all obstacles.
